title: Knockout Shooting Game II
description: A fast-paced elimination shooting game from the free-throw line with two balls in play, keeping every player engaged and shooting under pressure.

content.objective: Shoot quickly and accurately under the pressure of being chased by the next shooter in line.
content.setup: Players line up behind the free-throw line, two balls at the front of the line.
instructions: The first two players shoot; each may rebound their own miss and shoot again.
If the second shooter makes a shot before the first, the first player is eliminated.
The ball is passed back to the next player in line immediately after a make or elimination.
Play continues until only one player remains.
coachingPoints: Stay calm under the chase — rushed shots usually miss more.
Get the rebound and reset quickly rather than chasing a long one.
Use a consistent shooting motion even when hurried.
commonMistakes: Panicking and rushing a shot that was actually fine to take calmly.
Standing still after a miss instead of immediately rebounding.
Letting the elbow drift out to the side instead of staying under the ball.
content.safety: Keep the area under the basket clear for quick rebounds and resets.
